purpose: Prevent cross-sensor model mixing and prevent support/demo layers from being promoted to real red dust anomaly masks.

bindings.display_sensor: AIRS Aqua Dust Score / MODIS context
bindings.required_sensor_or_input: FY-4A AGRI multi-channel + MERRA-2 / ERA5 via LSDSSIMR
bindings.reason: Round 030 keeps Dust-Mamba and LSDSSIMR audits active, but checkpoint files and LSDSSIMR HDF5 inputs are still not local; current red pixels are rendered AIRS Dust Score support, not model inference.
bindings.next_required_action: Download/verify Dust-Mamba checkpoint and a small LSDSSIMR/FY-4A event sample before the coarse mask can be model output.

bindings.required_sensor_or_input: VIIRS corrected reflectance imagery with a runnable sandstorm segmentation model
bindings.current_mask_status: shape-filtered rendered AOT + Aerosol Type support mask
bindings.reason: Current medium red pixels are same-sensor VIIRS support evidence, but no runnable VIIRS dust segmentation weights/code are connected.
bindings.next_required_action: Connect a VIIRS-specific dust semantic segmentation model or a documented sensor-specific algorithm before the medium red mask is promoted.

bindings.current_ui_overlay: no current AOI red mask from this model
bindings.reason: Checkpoint and evaluation artifacts are local, but processed .npy inputs for the current AOI are missing.
bindings.next_required_action: Create or obtain a small processed MODIS input package and run actual inference before displaying MODIS model pixels as red dust anomalies.

bindings.required_sensor_or_input: same-event Sentinel-2 image and a Sentinel-2-specific dust/confounder segmentation model
bindings.current_mask_status: same-day SCL-screened raw Sentinel-2 AOT/B04/B08 support audit
bindings.current_ui_overlay: red same-day SCL-screened support cells, not Sentinel-2 dust model output
bindings.reason: The Sentinel-2 COG audit now uses same-day S2A_46SEJ_20210315_2_L2A AOT/B04/B08/SCL data, but AOT is aerosol support and no Sentinel-2 dust/not-dust segmentation model was executed.
bindings.next_required_action: Connect a Sentinel-2-specific dust/confounder model before any high-resolution red mask is promoted to real dust inference.
